verses.text: “Tell Israel: When a woman gives birth to a boy, she’ll be ceremonially unclean for seven days, just as during her monthly period. 🍼
“On the eighth day, circumcise the boy. 📅
“Then she’ll continue her purification for thirty-three days. She must not touch anything holy or enter the sanctuary until those days are complete. 🗓️
“If she gives birth to a girl, she’ll be ceremonially unclean for two weeks, as during her period. Her purification continues for sixty-six days. 🍼

“When her purification days are complete, for either a son or daughter, she must bring the priest at the Meeting Tent entrance a one-year-old lamb for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or turtledove for a sin offering. 🐑
“The priest will present them before Yahweh and make atonement for her. Then she’ll be clean from the flow of blood. This is the rule for a woman after giving birth to a boy or girl. 🕊️
“If she can’t afford a lamb, she may bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons—one as a burnt offering and one as a sin offering. The priest will make atonement for her, and she’ll be clean.” 🕊️
